inbox.title: Waiting for you
inbox.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}}
inbox.subtitleOverdue: {count, plural, one {# longer than promised} other {# longer than promised}}

group.expand: Show the submissions in this group
group.collapse: Hide the submissions in this group

empty.title: All reviewed
empty.body: Nothing in your groups is waiting for an answer. New work appears here the moment it is handed in.
empty.filteredBody: Clear them to see the rest of the queue.

inbox.failed: The queue could not be loaded.
inbox.selectBody: Choose one on the left and it opens here.

overdueBy.hours: {n, plural, one {# hour past} other {# hours past}}
overdueBy.days: {n, plural, one {# day past} other {# days past}}

age.spread: {n, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}}, oldest {oldest}

failed.title: This submission could not be opened
failed.body: It may have been decided, or the connection dropped. Try again from the queue.

conflict.title: {name} has just reviewed this
conflict.approved: Passed at {time}. Your draft is kept below.
conflict.returned: Returned for revision at {time}. Your draft is kept below.

windowExpired.title: You can no longer decide this one
windowExpired.body: Your assignment to this group ended after the work was handed in. You can read it; the verdict belongs to whoever teaches the group now.

lockExpired.title: Your marker on this submission ran out
lockExpired.body: The fifteen minutes are up. Nobody else has taken it — carry on, and it will be marked for you again as you work.

heldBy.title: {name} is looking at this one
heldBy.body: You are not blocked. It frees up in about fifteen minutes, and whoever decides first is the one who answers.

exerciseGone.title: The exercise is no longer there
exerciseGone.body: Its author deleted or moved it after this was handed in. The path above is the one the learner saw, and the verdict is still yours to give.

noDetails.title: The breakdown could not be built
noDetails.body: The answer is shown as it was handed in. Read it and decide as usual — the machine simply had nothing to compare it against.

previous.title: Returned for revision
previous.explain: This is a separate try. The answer below is the new one.

submission.closedVerbatim: {closed} of {total} closed by the machine, word for word
submission.essay: The work · {words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}

comment.sentencePlaceholder: What should the learner look at here?

decision.commentPlaceholder: A comment on the work as a whole. Write it in Norwegian — the æøå pad is below. Your draft is kept as you type.
decision.returnRequiresComment: Say what should be changed — the work goes back to the learner together with your comment.
decision.failed: The verdict could not be recorded. Try again.
decision.scoreIsServerSide: Sending back needs a comment: the learner gets the work together with it. The score is worked out by the system from what was passed — no mark is entered by hand.

dialog.title: Pass {count} submissions the machine closed?
dialog.body: These learners answered «{exercise}» exactly as the answer key has it, and nothing was left for a person to read.
dialog.irreversible: There is no undo. Each learner is told their work was passed, and the verdict is recorded in your name.

batch.done: {count, plural, one {# submission passed} other {# submissions passed}}

skipped.not_clean: {count} needs reading after all — the answer key has changed

batch.failed: Nothing was passed — the batch could not be sent.

oversight.title: Review
oversight.subtitle: Where work has piled up, and who could use a hand. A delay here is a sign of load.

period.label: Period the replies are counted over

summary.title: The school
summary.since: Counted from {date} — before that, submissions carried no school.
summary.sinceUnknown: Nothing has been handed in for review yet.
summary.medianNone: nothing was answered in this period
summary.truncated: The school has more waiting than this screen counts. The shape is right; the totals stop at the ceiling.

oversight.failed: The load could not be read.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.sub: Who is under pressure shows in the length of the tail, not in one number.
teachers.empty: Nothing is waiting on anyone right now.

courses.title: Courses
courses.sub: A course may promise a different response time
